title: First Americans split into northern and southern branches
summary: Genomes show Native Americans divided into northern and southern branches about 17,500-14,600 years ago. The founders were few, an effective size of about 70 by one estimate, then grew very fast.
why: Almost all Indigenous peoples from Canada to Patagonia trace back to these two branches.
superlativeSource: a single ancestral population, called 'First Americans'
